raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step reads `amount`, but raw_transactions has no such column; the source column is `txn_amount`. DuckDB reports this as a self-reference to the `amount` alias defined in the same SELECT. Other evidence (unique txn_id, single currency, status filter, unique customer and merchant keys) shows no other data problem, so pointing the cast at `txn_amount` while keeping the output column name `amount` should restore the pipeline.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(txn_amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
